transcript:
Hi, everyone, welcome to the A6 and Z podcast. I'm Sonal. Today, as part of our summer holiday podcast, we're continuing an occasional series. We started a while ago of articles read out loud in this podcast feed. You can find the first one in episode 544. It's time to build read out loud by Mark Andresen. What follows are three more modern classic pieces from A6 and Z, read out loud by their authors. You can also check out episode 500 on how we podcast where we touch
briefly on this trend in talking about audio and feeds. Finally, in case you missed it, be sure to also check out our show Journal Club, which is currently also in this feed, as well as our show 16 minutes, which you can subscribe to in its own feed by searching for it in your podcast app. Thank you for listening to the A6 and Z podcast.
